svg.title: flowchart diagram
svg.desc: A flowchart diagram with 17 nodes and 16 edges. flowing top to bottom. Key nodes: S8 install and rollback, RepoOwnership::ThisRepo, RepoOwnership::Foreign { repo }.. Key relationships: S8 install and rollback points to RepoOwnership::ThisRepo; S8 install and rollback points to RepoOwnership::Foreign { repo }; S8 install and rollback points to RepoOwnership::Unknown.. Layout spans 6262 by 357 units with 17 rendered node boxes and 16 routed edge paths.
